about: 회계 I › 매출/매입거래 › 매출전표 I(원본 2026-10-13 loginaa 실측: 부가세유형 카드매출 · 좋은컴퓨터 · 공급가액 100,000 → 부가세 10,000 · 적요 QA회계1 저장 → 칸이 처음으로, 회계거래조회 26/10/13-6 '매출전표 I', 전표 차) 외상매출금 110,000 / 대) 제품매출 100,000 · 부가세예수금 10,000). 우리 화면에서 같은 값을 넣고 저장 → 칸이 비고 → 회계전표 응답의 거래유형 · 부가세유형 · 세 줄 금액 → 지운다. node qa/shot.mjs qa/flows/vat-slip.json 두 번째: 세부내역 창(2 × 50,000 → 적용 → 공급가액 100,000 · 부가세 10,000) · 수수료 1,000(차) 지급수수료 831 / 대) 외상매출금, 원본 26/10/13-9) 저장 → 수정 창(?journal=)에서 공급가액 200,000 저장 → 목록으로, 분개 220,000.

shots.name: 매출전표 I 카드매출 저장 → 분개 · 부가세유형
steps: js:(async () => { const p = (await fetch('/api/partners', { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + localStorage.getItem('erp_token') } }).then((r) => r.json()))[0]; sessionStorage.setItem('vsP', p.code); return p.code })()

js:(() => { const s = document.querySelector('select[aria-label="부가세유형"]'); Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLSelectElement.prototype, 'value').set.call(s, '카드매출'); s.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); return true })()
js:(() => { (document.querySelector('button[title="거래처 코드도움"]') ?? document.querySelector('button[title="거래처 선택"]')).click(); return true })()

js:(() => { const set = (el, v) => { Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value').set.call(el, v); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })) }; set(document.querySelector('input[aria-label="공급가액"]'), '100000'); set(document.querySelector('input[placeholder="적요"]'), 'QA회계1 매출전표'); return true })()

expect:(async () => { const d = new Date(); const ymd = d.getFullYear() + '-' + String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0') + '-' + String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0'); const j = (await fetch('/api/journals?from=' + ymd + '&to=' + ymd + '&all=true', { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + localStorage.getItem('erp_token') } }).then((r) => r.json())).rows.find((r) => r.description === 'QA회계1 매출전표'); sessionStorage.setItem('vsJ', j.id); const amt = (code, side) => Number((j.lines.find((l) => l.accountCode === code) ?? {})[side] ?? 0); return j.sourceTypeName === '매출전표 I' && j.vatType === '카드매출' && amt('108', 'debit') === 110000 && amt('404', 'credit') === 100000 && amt('255', 'credit') === 10000 })()
expect:(async () => (await fetch('/api/journals/' + sessionStorage.getItem('vsJ'), { method: 'DELETE', headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + localStorage.getItem('erp_token') } })).ok)()

shots.name: 매출전표 I 세부내역 · 수수료 → 수정 창
steps: js:(async () => { const d = new Date(); const ymd = d.getFullYear() + '-' + String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0') + '-' + String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0'); const old = (await fetch('/api/journals?from=' + ymd + '&to=' + ymd + '&all=true', { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + localStorage.getItem('erp_token') } }).then((r) => r.json())).rows.filter((r) => r.description === 'QA회계1 세부내역'); for (const j of old) await fetch('/api/journals/' + j.id, { method: 'DELETE', headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + localStorage.getItem('erp_token') } }); return old.length })()

js:(async () => { const p = (await fetch('/api/partners', { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + localStorage.getItem('erp_token') } }).then((r) => r.json()))[0]; sessionStorage.setItem('vsP', p.code); return p.code })()
js:(() => { (document.querySelector('button[title="거래처 코드도움"]') ?? document.querySelector('button[title="거래처 선택"]')).click(); return true })()

js:(() => { const set = (el, v) => { Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value').set.call(el, v); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })) }; set(document.querySelector('input[aria-label="1줄 품명"]'), 'QA회계1-품'); set(document.querySelector('input[aria-label="1줄 수량"]'), '2'); return true })()

js:(() => { const set = (el, v) => { Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value').set.call(el, v); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })) }; set(document.querySelector('input[aria-label="1줄 단가"]'), '50000'); return true })()

js:(() => { const set = (el, v) => { Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value').set.call(el, v); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })) }; set(document.querySelector('input[aria-label="수수료"]'), '1000'); set(document.querySelector('input[placeholder="적요"]'), 'QA회계1 세부내역'); return true })()

expect:(async () => { const d = new Date(); const ymd = d.getFullYear() + '-' + String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0') + '-' + String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0'); const j = (await fetch('/api/journals?from=' + ymd + '&to=' + ymd + '&all=true', { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + localStorage.getItem('erp_token') } }).then((r) => r.json())).rows.find((r) => r.description === 'QA회계1 세부내역'); sessionStorage.setItem('vsJ2', j.id); const amt = (code, side) => j.lines.filter((l) => l.accountCode === code).reduce((a, l) => a + Number(l[side]), 0); return amt('108', 'debit') === 110000 && amt('831', 'debit') === 1000 && amt('108', 'credit') === 1000 && j.vatDetail && j.vatDetail.items.length === 1 && j.eInvoiceKind === '전자(세금)계산서-신규' && j.vatOmitted === false })()

js:(() => { const set = (el, v) => { Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value').set.call(el, v); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })) }; set(document.querySelector('input[aria-label="공급가액"]'), '200000'); return true })()

expect:(async () => { const j = await fetch('/api/journals/' + sessionStorage.getItem('vsJ2'), { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + localStorage.getItem('erp_token') } }).then((r) => r.json()); const amt = (code, side) => j.lines.filter((l) => l.accountCode === code).reduce((a, l) => a + Number(l[side]), 0); return amt('108', 'debit') === 220000 && amt('255', 'credit') === 20000 && amt('831', 'debit') === 1000 && !!j.updatedBy })()
expect:(async () => (await fetch('/api/journals/' + sessionStorage.getItem('vsJ2'), { method: 'DELETE', headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + localStorage.getItem('erp_token') } })).ok)()
